description: AstraAspera is a multidisciplinary team for Abandoned but Not Forgotten, we want to bring the stories of humanity’s abandoned spacecraft and hardware back and we’re especially interested in what these objects can teach us about the history and future of human space exploration. We’re looking for teammates interested in storytelling, design, web development, space exploration, and multimedia.
summary: “Spirit is still on Mars.” is an interactive game and website that bring NASA’s Spirit rover’s story to life for children. Players become Spirit, explore Mars and investigate rocks while facing challenges from the mission. The website connects the adventure to real NASA photographs and scientific evidence. Our goal is to spark curiosity about space and show why Spirit’s discoveries still matter, even though the rover has stopped communicating.
details: “Spirit is still on Mars.” is an interactive game and website that help children ages 8–12 learn about NASA’s Spirit rover and why its discoveries still matter. In the game, players become Spirit and follow its journey from launch to its final winter. They drive across Mars, learn about scientific tools and investigate rocks and soil. Players can ask mission control for help, earn Stars through questions and complete activities while recharging. A broken wheel becomes part of the story, showing how an engineering problem helped uncover evidence of past water. The website connects the game to NASA photographs. Visitors can follow a mission timeline, examine images in an Evidence Lab and try to locate Spirit in a photograph taken from orbit. We built the game in Scratch and the website with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, hosted through GitHub Pages. NASA mission records and scientific research informed the content. Spirit’s personality and dialogue are fictional, while mission activities and energy timers are simplified for play. We combined storytelling with scientific investigation to make the mission easier to understand and remember. We considered children’s reading levels and attention spans, using short explanations, clear controls and opportunities to retry questions. The game works best on a computer with a keyboard. Our goal is to spark curiosity about space and show that equipment left behind can still have lasting value. Spirit stopped communicating, but what it taught us about Mars remains.
